new_value: TX slot deletion now fails closed via the durable TX-initialization marker. store_tx_state captures marker_existed before _ensure_tx_marker and passes it into _write_to_older_slot(_locked) as initialized_marker; when a pre-existing marker coincides with no recoverable anchored slot state, the store raises 'initialized TX state was deleted' — bootstrap authorization does not override durable evidence of prior initialization, so Origin Sequence 1 cannot be reused. load_tx_state now raises unconditionally (independent of legacy fail_closed) when the marker exists: absent slot files report deletion, invalid slot files report 'TX state corrupt'. Mirrors the RX catalog pattern (durable in-dir evidence surviving a stateless anchor record). Documented in the class docstring (TX initialization marker section). New tests: deleted slots fail closed while bootstrap authorized (load + store of seq 1 and seq 8), corrupt slots + marker fail closed, entire-store wipe boundary returns to authorized bootstrap, lost marker with intact anchored store self-heals. The two hole-tests verified to fail against the old code via temporary revert.
